text:
lina: Heads up: PR #4478 renames /rerank request param. old boolean `normalize_scores` -> new enum `score_mode` with values `none|minmax|softmax`. Top-of-file examples and SDK snippets still use the old boolean. Need docs + snippet sweep before merge.

remy: Thanks. Which snippets are present? I see examples for curl, python, js, and Go. Also an inline OpenAPI example needs updating.

josh: Runtime supports both forms for now but will stop accepting the boolean in the next minor. Docs should show canonical enum strings, an explicit `none` example, and a short migration note mapping true->softmax, false->none (and explain minmax behavior).

lina: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4478  - changed request schema + added `score_mode` enum to OpenAPI.

sdk-bot: Added tasks: update SDK snippets (python/js/go), update curl examples, update OpenAPI example object, add migration blurb to CHANGELOG and API ref.

remy: I'll patch the JS and curl examples. Proposed JS snippet change:

```js
const res = await client.rerank({
  model: 'rw-rank',
  queries: ['q1'],
  candidates: ['a','b'],
  score_mode: 'softmax' // none|minmax|softmax
});
```

josh: I'll handle Python and Go. For CHANGELOG, suggest a one-paragraph note: "Deprecated boolean `normalize_scores`; please migrate to `score_mode` enum. Boolean will be accepted for 2 weeks after release; recommended mappings: true->softmax, false->none."

lina: Also add a short code snippet for batch migration (jq sed) in the migration note. And add a deprecation banner on the /rerank API ref page.

docs-bot: Reminder set: run docs build after snippets updated. Marking PR as needs-docs-review.

remy: Pushing patch in a minute, will request reviews from @lina and @josh when ready.

lina: Great — merge after CI passes and docs review. :thumbsup:
